name: amjad1233
description: Amjad's open-source Claude Code skills — each a complete, standalone plugin. Add the marketplace once, install whichever skills you want.

plugins.name: agent-army
plugins.description: Run a fleet of autonomous Claude Code agents in parallel — one per independent seam, each in its own git worktree, coordinated by a changeable master through an on-disk command centre. Opens with a Front Door interview that routes cheap work elsewhere.

plugins.name: continuation
plugins.description: Project memory for any coding agent. Decisions, learnings, conventions and session handoffs as typed records in .continuation/, written autonomously, read in one hot file every session. /end, /continue, /remember, /continuation-review, /next.
